system.description:
You possess some form of reader lens, which may take the form of a pair of glasses, goggles, a monocle, contact lenses, or other surface onto which a display is projected, and you’ve studied how to read those displays. If this device is lost, damaged, or destroyed, this talent also allows you to construct a replacement.

When you interact with a computer system using a weaving action, you may receive a visual display from the machine. This allows you to receive a wide range of information from the machine, including spending Momentum to Obtain Information from the machine. This also allows for much more precise and efficient control of computer systems: when you purchase one or more dice on a Skill Test to perform a weaving action, you may spend two additional Spirit to count one of the dice in your dice pool as if it had rolled a 1. This must be done before rolling.
